title: Demethylzeylasteral ameliorates podocyte damage in murine lupus by inhibiting inflammation and enhancing autophagy.
authors: Shen, Pan; Deng, Xuan; Chen, Zhe; Chen, Min; Han, Liang; Chen, Xiaoqi; Tu, Shenghao
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物DML通过抑制IL-17A/JAK2-STAT3通路改善狼疮性肾炎足细胞损伤，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a chronic autoimmune disease with multiorgan and tissue involvement. Lupus nephritis (LN), an inflammatory condition of the kidneys associated with SLE, represents a significant cause of morbidity and mortality in SLE patients. Current immunosuppressive therapies for LN have limited efficacy and can lead to significant side effects. Demethylzeylasteral (DML) has shown promise in the treatment of LN, but its precise mechanism of action remains unclear. PURPOSE: To assess the therapeutic effects and potential molecular mechanisms of DML in LN METHODS: The study evaluated the renal protective effects of DML in MRL/lpr mice through assessments of immune complex levels, renal function, and pathological changes. Network pharmacology and transcriptomics approaches were used to elucidate the underlying mechanisms. Molecular docking, biacore assay, monoclonal antibody blocking experiments, and in vitro studies were conducted to verify the mechanisms of action. RESULTS: DML treatment reduced levels of anti-Sm and anti-dsDNA IgG antibodies, as well as serum creatinine and blood urea nitrogen levels. DML also mitigated glomerular damage and fibrosis. Mechanistically, DML alleviated podocyte damage by suppressing inflammation and enhancing autophagy through inhibition of the IL-17A/JAK2-STAT3 pathways. Additionally, DML exhibited high binding affinity with IL17A, JAK2, and STAT3. CONCLUSION: These findings provide strong evidence for the beneficial effects of DML in LN, suggesting its potential as a novel therapeutic strategy for improving renal function in autoimmune kidney diseases.
abstract_zh: 背景：系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）是一种累及多器官和组织的慢性自身免疫性疾病。狼疮性肾炎（LN）是与SLE相关的肾脏炎症性疾病，是SLE患者发病和死亡的重要原因。目前针对LN的免疫抑制疗法疗效有限，且可能导致显著副作用。去甲基泽拉醛（DML）在LN治疗中显示出潜力，但其确切作用机制尚不明确。目的：评估DML在LN中的治疗效果及潜在分子机制。方法：研究通过评估免疫复合物水平、肾功能和病理变化，评价DML在MRL/lpr小鼠中的肾脏保护作用。采用网络药理学和转录组学方法阐明其潜在机制。通过分子对接、biacore检测、单克隆抗体阻断实验及体外研究验证其作用机制。结果：DML治疗降低了抗Sm和抗dsDNA IgG抗体水平，以及血清肌酐和血尿素氮水平。DML还减轻了肾小球损伤和纤维化。机制上，DML通过抑制IL-17A/JAK2-STAT3通路，抑制炎症并增强自噬，从而减轻足细胞损伤。此外，DML与IL17A、JAK2和STAT3表现出高结合亲和力。结论：这些发现为DML在LN中的有益作用提供了有力证据，提示其作为改善自身免疫性肾脏疾病肾功能的潜在新型治疗策略。
